page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7.32xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance running on the KVM hypervisor. It features 128 dedicated physical cores and 128 vCPUs, utilizing Intel Xeon 8369B processors operating at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The system is configured with 1.0 thread per core, ensuring dedicated execution resources per vCPU.

The instance is equipped with 512.0 GB of RAM, providing a balanced memory-to-core ratio of 4.0 GB per core. It does not include any local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached volumes. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 64 Gbps, facilitating high-throughput data transfers.

Given its high resource density and dedicated CPU allocation, the instance offers a robust platform for enterprise workloads requiring substantial parallel processing capabilities without GPU acceleration. The absence of local storage and bundled public IPv4 addresses highlights a design optimized for network-reliant architectures. It is suited for large-scale general-purpose workloads, enterprise applications, and distributed database nodes.

This hardware profile is designed for resource-intensive, multi-threaded enterprise applications, web serving, and distributed databases that require high network throughput and dedicated compute resources without the need for local NVMe drives or GPU acceleration.
